I have been with this surgery for the majority of my life and they have been utterly and completely useless for the most part. Don’t get me wrong, some of the staff members here are nothing but lovely, however unfortunately many of the staff rude, unkind and do not care to listen to any concerns.
They completely refused to listened to me when I said I can barely eat or drink anything at all and said that I’ll get better on my own, insisting I was ‘completely fit and healthy’ just because I was young, with not even a glance at my record which would dispute that.
They told me I should’ve gone to a pharmacy first and then when I went to said pharmacy and filled out the online form it said I should go to the GP as my symptoms were too severe. Funny that. Luckily, the pharmacist was able to help and took one look at me and gave me the support and help I needed.
This has not just been one experience, this has been one of many, many times and I’ve finally had enough.
If you want a doctor’s surgery that will ridicule you, not listen to anything you say, claim you’re perfectly healthy, refuse to look at your chart and lose your appointments on the regular, I highly recommend this surgery. A few bad apples will spoil the bunch unfortunately, so I will be moving GP ASAP.",null,[0,236]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tSNGRqRklNRW8zYTBkdlVURmtVRWRVYm01RGRFRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xc7ff5f35f46da5f9!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOkR4djFIMEo3a0dvUTFkUEdUbm5DdEE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tSNGRqRklNRW8zYTBkdlVURmtVRWRVYm01RGRFRRAB&t=1&__HKgswZGMxWkRGVjFXZA&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwi_jbOXx7CTAxWIFGMBHVF6Ot4QoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwi_jbOXx7CTAxWIFGMBHVF6Ot4Q0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMDV0V0RaQk4xOWZSV2hDT1c5Uk5XdHBRMWx0Wm5CbU56Sk5iMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpSYzBOWk1scG1iMFJ6V1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tzMmN6WTBOVU52Tm5Wck5uSmlhR1pHTWtVM1lYYxAB",["0x0:0xc7ff5f35f46da5f9",null,1761023727418988,1761023727418988,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/112489612926700114358/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["lee croucher","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWdHCtlxCSQwD_sXNMdnqgaRR78Rs14XqdgS26OI5nZ4H6H7v2L=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/112489612926700114358?hl=en"],"112489612926700114358",null,51,6,null,[1,5,1],3,["Local Guide · 51 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwi_jbOXx7CTAxWIFGMBHVF6Ot4Q7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"5 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[3],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Depending on who you speak to, you will get help.
I rang over 9 days ago for a repeat prescription, then to be told I have to request my medication every month. As its no longer on repeat.
Not an issue, so I thought (as I ordered it over the phone.
Went in yesterday 20th October, to find out the Dr looked at my repeat prescription and then cancelled it, without telling me ?
The Pharmacy ladies were polite and friendly, and told me if I spoke to someone in the reception they can book me in. Went to reception and was then told I had to do this online ? So I advised that the Pharmacy said I could book it through reception, he went to speak to his colleague again, and was told in no terms they could help me and I had to do this on line ?

Really does 1 team not know what the other team is doing ? Or is it just pure laziness as they could of booked me in for an appointment while I was in reception. There was actually a Gentleman before me who was able to get an appointment for the next day ? Is it a case if your face or name fits, you will help them out !! I was not advised that the Dt didn't sign off for my repeat prescription, it was just on the notes and 1 lady said im not sure why they have done that ? Why didn't someone contact me ? And advise what i needed to do ? Instead of me having to come in and hit a brick wall, because 1 member off staff didn't want to help ?

Until now this Surgery has been amazing, but listening to a few residents in my area  they are are proving to be right about the service they get depending on whom you speak to in reception.

And before anyone replies about this is now standard procedure, why couldnt I have been told this when I requested my medicine.

Now I cant even log in !!

Regards
